summary: Both parts of FR-01.37 are implemented as written. (1) The validator no longer rejects boolean default:true (actions-schema-validator.ts). boolean+required is still rejected with invalid_param_required, and a test covers it even when default:true is also set. In the modal init effect (useNewIssueFormDerived.ts), initialBooleanValue seeds a default:true boolean as true, and ParamField renders booleans from value===true, so the box opens pre-checked and can be unchecked. explicitParamEntries still drops a false or unset boolean, so an unchecked box emits no flag, and nothing was added server-side that applies optional defaults. (2) SLASH_COMMAND_PATTERN now allows the skill token plus plain flags (--x, -x, --x=value with [A-Za-z0-9_.-] values). It rejects quotes, ;, $, |, spaces inside values and bare non-flag tokens, and the tests cover each of those. The spec.md and guide.md updates match the behaviour. The new unit and e2e tests are in scope. I did not run any tests.
